mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sc_follow f, sc_table_data d, tb_user u WHERE f.data_id = d.data_id AND d.user_id = u.user_id and d.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT u.* FROM sc_follow f, tb_user u WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.user_id = f.user_id
SELECT u.* FROM sc_follow f, tb_user u, `sc_shop` s WHERE s.shop_id = f.`shop_id` AND f.`user_id` = u.`user_id` and f.type =2 AND s.`user_id` = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id order by create_time desc
